description: The 0.17.0 regression seed as an executable registry. Each class is a recurring bug type mined from the dreams journal, sprint retros, events, and CLAUDE.md/MIGRATION.md/UPDATE.md hygiene sections (ROADMAP 'Mandatory regression seed'). `detector.run` (when non-null) is a node command the test-suite runner executes; exit 0 = class currently held closed, non-zero = possible regression. status: covered (real detector) | partial (detector approximates) | gap (no detector yet — the suite's backlog).

classes.name: Hollow ladder rung (version bumped, no capsule)

detector.notes: Consumer-only: resolves the capsule for /warp:update. N/A in canonical (canonical is the source). Role-aware enforcer should run this only in consumer installs — interim flag pending the shared repo-role resolver.

Consumer/update-oriented: checks capsule release.json#migrations[] before /warp:update applies. N/A in canonical — role-aware enforcer runs it only in consumer installs (pending the shared repo-role resolver).
No standing detector. Candidate: lint scripts/ for execSync with backslash-escaped format strings / unquoted % on Windows.

classes.name: Windows stdin / argv limits in dispatch

detector.notes: Guard-test covers the route-guard watchlist; does not measure argv length directly.
